truth_method: Manual visual transcription from original image before first inference; upstream XML is OCR output and was not copied as truth. Preserve handwritten 日くらし rather than canonical modernization 日ぐらし. Include visible end comma in row 3 and end period in row 5.
evaluation: Not previously used by this branch; public upstream example may overlap model training. Not an unseen-model claim. No text normalization. Initially evaluate without runtime changes.
